BUSINESS STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.

2. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   B. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   C. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   B. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

4. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   D. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.
   C. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   B. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.
   D. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.
   B. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.

8. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   B. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

10. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.
   C. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

12. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.

13. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

14. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.
   B. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.
   D. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.
   B. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.
   D. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Price Determination and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Procurement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain The Ledger and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
